components.name: Selection button
components.css: .ds-choice { min-height: 56px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #1467b6; border-radius: 9px; background: #edf5ff; color: #075aa4; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-choice:hover { background: #dcecff; } .ds-choice:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #7cb2ed; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Price input
components.description: Enter the price of the entire pack.
components.css: .ds-price { height: 58px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #a9b7c7; border-radius: 9px; color: #182b3d; font-size: 21px; } .ds-price:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #7cb2ed; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Unit-price result
components.description: Show the normalized price and inputs used in the calculation.
components.css: .ds-result { padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #cbdff3; border-radius: 12px; background: #eef5fc; color: #1d2935; } .ds-result p { color: #075aa4; font-size: 34px; font-weight: 800; }

narrative.overview: BeerDang is a utility used while shopping. The calculator and its answer appear immediately; branding, decorative imagery, slogans, and marketing sections do not compete with the task.
dos: Do put the price input and 10ml answer on the first mobile screen.
Do keep labels, values, and units unambiguous.
donts: Don't add a hero, badges, decorative graphics, or fake navigation to this working screen.
